purpose: Restore the existing ShorelySafe welcome overlay, its original deferred controller, progress/focus handling and renderer-ready handoff at the user's explicit request. Remove only the two early loader/app visibility overrides and update the dedicated later lifecycle block so it reveals controls only after nw-app-loading ends. Keep every stable pane, boundary, typography, view-toggle and scientific change intact. Exact fragment inverses preserve independent original extraction hashes; the controller asset remains byte-for-byte unchanged and its script tag uses its content hash.
